name: X (Twitter)
_comment_downloader: 'ytdlp' hands both the metadata and the download to yt-dlp instead of Selenium, so this adapter needs no selectors. X builds its player from signed API calls, which yt-dlp's extractor already tracks. Posts that need a logged-in account (age-restricted ones) need a Netscape cookies.txt exported from your browser, saved as <media root>/cookies.txt (/data/cookies.txt in Docker) or pointed at by OASIS_COOKIES_FILE.
_comment_code: Tweet ids are 19 digits, far wider than the catalog's AAA-123 code shape, so codes are handed out in order: X-01, X-02 ... Re-analysing the same URL keeps its number.
